subject: אנגלית
title: אוצר מילים למבחן באנגלית
source: דף ״אוצר מילים למבחן באנגלית״ מהכיתה: 86 מילים וביטויים

words.ex: I have a hundred stickers.
words.gap: Fifty plus fifty is ___.
words.tip: אפשר לומר גם one hundred. a hundred = 100.

words.ex: There are fourteen kids in my class.
words.exHe: יש ארבעה עשר ילדים בכיתה שלי.
words.gap: Seven plus seven is ___.
words.tip: fourteen: אחרי four יש u, בניגוד ל-forty (40) שאין בו u. ההטעמה על teen.

words.ex: My sister is fifteen years old.
words.gap: Ten plus five is ___.
words.tip: fifteen ≠ five: כותבים fif ולא five.

words.ex: You can drive a car at sixteen in some countries.
words.exHe: בכמה מדינות אפשר לנהוג בגיל שש עשרה.
words.gap: Eight plus eight is ___.
words.tip: six + teen. הסיומת teen = ״עשרה״.

words.ex: Seventeen children came to the party.
words.gap: Ten plus seven is ___.
words.tip: seven + teen: שימו לב שה-e הסופי של seven נשאר, seventeen.

words.ex: Eighteen plus two is twenty.
words.exHe: שמונה עשרה ועוד שתיים הם עשרים.
words.gap: Nine plus nine is ___.
words.tip: eighteen: כותבים eigh+teen. יש רק t אחד באמצע.

words.ex: Nineteen is one less than twenty.
words.exHe: תשע עשרה זה אחד פחות מעשרים.
words.gap: Ten plus nine is ___.
words.tip: nine + teen. אין לשכוח את ה-e בסוף nine.

words.ex: My grandfather is forty years old.
words.gap: Twenty plus twenty is ___.
words.tip: forty (40) נכתב בלי u. four (4) ו-fourteen (14) כן עם u.

words.ex: The book costs fifty shekels.
words.gap: Twenty-five plus twenty-five is ___.
words.tip: fifty ולא fivety: five הופך ל-fif.

words.ex: Seventy minutes is one hour and ten minutes.
words.exHe: שבעים דקות זה שעה ועוד עשר דקות.
words.gap: Thirty plus forty is ___.
words.tip: seventy = seven + ty.

words.ex: My grandmother is eighty years old.
words.gap: Forty plus forty is ___.
words.tip: eighty: eigh+ty. יש רק t אחד: eight → eighty.

words.ex: Ninety is ten less than a hundred.
words.gap: Fifty plus forty is ___.
words.tip: ninety: nine+ty, אבל בלי e. (nineteen כן עם e: nine+teen.)

words.ex: It is cold in January.
words.gap: The first month of the year is ___.
words.tip: חודשים באנגלית תמיד באות גדולה: January.

words.ex: February is the shortest month.
words.gap: The month after January is ___.
words.tip: שימו לב ל-r הראשון: Feb-ru-ary.

words.ex: Spring begins in March.
words.gap: The month before April is ___.
words.tip: March = מרץ. גם marching = צעדה.

words.ex: It rains a lot in April.
words.gap: The month after March is ___.
words.tip: April נכתב עם p אחד: A-p-r-i-l.

words.ex: The flowers are beautiful in May.
words.gap: The month between April and June is ___.
words.tip: May באות גדולה הוא חודש. may באות קטנה = אולי / מותר.

words.ex: School ends in June.
words.gap: The month after May is ___.
words.tip: June ו-July נשמעים דומים בעברית. June = יוני, July = יולי.

words.ex: We go to the beach in July.
words.gap: The month between June and August is ___.
words.tip: July: ההטעמה על ההברה השנייה.

words.ex: August is very hot.
words.gap: The month before September is ___.
words.tip: August: au (כמו בעברית ״או״).

words.ex: School begins in September.
words.gap: The month after August is ___.
words.tip: September: ההטעמה על tem.

words.ex: My birthday is in October.
words.gap: The month between September and November is ___.
words.tip: October: ההטעמה על to.

words.ex: It starts to rain in November.
words.gap: The month before December is ___.
words.tip: November: ההטעמה על vem.

words.ex: December is the last month of the year.
words.gap: The last month of the year is ___.
words.tip: December: ההטעמה על cem.

words.ex: The lesson begins at eight o'clock.
words.gap: The movie will ___ at six o'clock.
words.tip: begin = start. הצורה בעבר: began.

words.ex: I call my grandma every Friday.
words.exHe: אני מתקשר לסבתא כל יום שישי.
words.gap: I want to ___ Grandma on the phone.
words.tip: call me = התקשרו אליי. call גם = לקרוא בשם: They call him Danny.

words.ex: Babies cry when they are hungry.
words.gap: Babies ___ when they are hungry.
words.tip: cry → cries (he cries), לא crys.

words.ex: I cannot find my keys.
words.gap: I cannot ___ my keys. Where are they?
words.tip: find (למצוא) ≠ look for (לחפש). קודם מחפשים, ואז מוצאים.

words.ex: I give my dog water every day.
words.exHe: אני נותן לכלב מים כל יום.
words.gap: Please ___ me a glass of water.
words.tip: give אינו נגמר ב-v: g-i-v-e. give me = תנו לי.

words.ex: Can you help me with my homework?
words.exHe: אתה יכול לעזור לי בשיעורי הבית?
words.gap: Can you ___ me with my homework?
words.tip: help גם שם עצם: I need help! = אני צריך עזרה!

words.ex: We learn new words every day.
words.exHe: אנחנו לומדים מילים חדשות כל יום.
words.gap: Children ___ new things at school every day.
words.tip: learn = לרכוש ידע. ea באמצע: l-ea-rn.

words.ex: Please put your bag on the chair.
words.exHe: בבקשה שים את התיק על הכיסא.
words.gap: Please ___ your books on the table.
words.tip: put לא משתנה בעבר: put – put – put.

words.ex: You can choose red or blue.
words.exHe: אתם יכולים לבחור אדום או כחול.
words.gap: It is hard to ___ between pizza and pasta.
words.tip: choose נכתב עם oo ונשמע choos (כמו ״צו״). בעבר: chose.

words.ex: I look for my glasses in my room.
words.exHe: אני מחפש את המשקפיים בחדר שלי.
words.gap: I am going to ___ my lost cat in the garden.
words.tip: look for = לחפש. look at = להסתכל על. שימו לב לצירוף.

words.ex: I take care of my little brother.
words.gap: I ___ my little brother after school.
words.tip: take care of + מי שדואגים לו: take care of the dog. Take care! = שמרו על עצמכם!

words.ex: I hope we win the game.
words.gap: I hope our team will ___ the race and get a medal.
words.tip: win בעבר: won. ההפך: lose (להפסיד).

words.ex: What a beautiful flower!
words.gap: What a ___ flower! It is red and yellow.
words.tip: beau + ti + ful. ״beau״ נשמע ״ביו״.

words.ex: She is my best friend.
words.gap: She is my ___ friend.
words.tip: good → better → best. best = הכי טוב.

words.ex: Today I feel better.
words.gap: I was sick, but today I feel ___.
words.tip: better יש שני t. good → better → best.

words.ex: The shop is closed on Saturday.
words.gap: The shop is ___ on Saturday. We cannot go in.
words.tip: ההפך: open (פתוח). closed מגיע מ-close.

words.ex: A cat and a dog are different animals.
words.gap: A cat and a dog are ___ animals.
words.tip: different: שני f! dif-fer-ent. ההפך: the same.

words.ex: A cheetah runs very fast.
words.gap: A cheetah runs very ___.
words.tip: fast גם תואר (a fast car) וגם תואר פועל (run fast). ההפך: slow.

words.ex: This test is very hard.
words.gap: This test is very ___. I do not know the answers.
words.tip: hard = קשה (גם קשה כמו אבן וגם קשה כמו מבחן). ההפך: easy.

words.ex: It is important to drink water.
words.gap: It is ___ to drink water every day.
words.tip: important: im + por + tant. ההטעמה באמצע.

words.ex: My new teacher is very nice.
words.gap: My new teacher is very ___. She always smiles.
words.tip: Nice to meet you! = נעים להכיר!

words.ex: I have an old bike.
words.gap: My grandfather is 80 years ___.
words.tip: old: ישן (a old bike) וגם זקן. How old are you? = בן כמה אתה?

words.ex: I stay at home when I am sick.
words.gap: I have a fever, so I am ___.
words.tip: sick = חולה. ההפך: healthy (בריא).

words.ex: This is my first day at school.
words.exHe: זה היום הראשון שלי בבית הספר.
words.gap: She ran fastest, so she was ___ in the race.
words.tip: first, second, third. first = 1st. ההפך: last.

words.ex: See you next week!
words.gap: Please wait. Who is ___ in the line?
words.tip: next week, next year, next to (ליד). ההפך: last / previous.

words.ex: We have a lot of books.
words.gap: We have ___ books in our class, more than a hundred.
words.tip: a lot of = הרבה (גם ספירים וגם לא ספירים: a lot of water).

words.ex: I like pizza. I also like pasta.
words.exHe: אני אוהב פיצה. אני גם אוהב פסטה.
words.gap: Dan has a dog. He ___ has a cat.
words.tip: also עומד לפני הפועל הרגיל: I also like. (ואחרי am/is/are: I am also.)

words.ex: I always brush my teeth.
words.gap: The sun ___ rises in the east.
words.tip: always = בכל פעם. ההפך: never (אף פעם).

words.ex: We see the stars at night.
words.gap: We see the stars ___, when it is dark.
words.tip: at night = בלילה. ההפך: during the day (ביום).

words.ex: I am happy because it is my birthday.
words.exHe: אני שמח כי זה יום ההולדת שלי.
words.gap: I am happy ___ it is my birthday.
words.tip: because עונה על השאלה why? ואחריו משפט שלם.

words.ex: I want to play, but I have homework.
words.exHe: אני רוצה לשחק, אבל יש לי שיעורי בית.
words.gap: I want to play, ___ I have homework.
words.tip: but מחבר שני דברים הפוכים. נכתב b-u-t.

words.ex: I read every day.
words.gap: I drink water ___ morning.
words.tip: every + יחיד: every day, every week. (לא every days!)

words.ex: This gift is for you.
words.gap: This gift is ___ you, Dan.
words.tip: for you = בשבילך. for גם = במשך: for two hours.

words.ex: If it rains, we stay home.
words.gap: ___ it rains, we stay home.
words.tip: if + תנאי: אם קורה X, אז Y. נכתב if (שתי אותיות).

words.ex: Put the books into the bag.
words.gap: The boy jumps ___ the pool.
words.tip: into = תנועה פנימה (in + to). in = בפנים.

words.ex: I'm sorry, I broke your cup.
words.exHe: אני מצטער, שברתי את הכוס שלך.
words.gap: I broke your cup. ___!
words.tip: I'm sorry = I am sorry. sorry נכתב עם שני r.

words.ex: He runs like the wind.
words.gap: He runs ___ the wind.
words.tip: like = כמו (a bird like a plane). like גם = לאהוב: I like pizza.

words.ex: I want more water, please.
words.gap: Can I have ___ cake, please? I am still hungry.
words.tip: more = עוד / יותר. ההפך: less. more than = יותר מ.

words.ex: My school is near my house.
words.exHe: בית הספר שלי קרוב לבית שלי.
words.gap: My school is ___ my house, only two minutes away.
words.tip: near = קרוב. ההפך: far (רחוק).

words.ex: I am eating now.
words.gap: Come here ___! We are late.
words.tip: now = עכשיו. ההפך: later (אחר כך).

words.ex: I have one pen. Where is the other pen?
words.exHe: יש לי עט אחד. איפה העט השני?
words.gap: One shoe is here. Where is the ___ shoe?
words.tip: other + שם עצם: the other shoe. another = עוד אחד.

words.ex: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
words.gap: I do not know. ___ it will rain tomorrow.
words.tip: perhaps = maybe. נשמע ״פרהפס״.

words.ex: What is your age?
words.gap: What is your ___? I am nine years old.
words.tip: age = גיל. at the age of ten = בגיל עשר.

words.ex: My birthday is in October.
words.gap: We eat cake and get presents on my ___.
words.tip: birth (לידה) + day (יום). Happy birthday! = יום הולדת שמח!

words.ex: We play outside during the break.
words.gap: We play outside during the ___ at school.
words.tip: break = הפסקה, וגם: לשבור (break a cup). ea נקרא ״ei״.

words.ex: I gave my mom a flower.
words.gap: A rose is a red ___.
words.tip: flower. שימו לב ל-w. הרבים: flowers.

words.ex: I have a good idea!
words.gap: I have a good ___! Let's bake a cake.
words.tip: idea = רעיון. נשמע ״איי-דיא״.

words.ex: The kid is playing with a ball.
words.gap: That ___ is eight years old and he loves football.
words.tip: kid = ילד (בשפה יומיומית). הרבים: kids.

words.ex: I need money to buy a book.
words.exHe: אני צריך כסף כדי לקנות ספר.
words.gap: I need ___ to buy a new book.
words.tip: money = כסף. נקרא ״מאני״, לא ״מוֹני״.

words.ex: April is the fourth month of the year.
words.gap: April is the fourth ___ of the year.
words.tip: month = חודש. בשנה 12 months.

words.ex: Many people live in this city.
words.gap: Many ___ live in this city.
words.tip: people = רבים (אנשים). האות o וה-e: peo-ple.

words.ex: The car drives on the road.
words.gap: The car drives on the ___.
words.tip: road = דרך / כביש. oa נקרא ״אוֹ״ כמו boat.

words.ex: I sleep under a warm blanket.
words.gap: It is cold, so I want a warm ___.
words.tip: blanket = שמיכה. blan + ket.

words.ex: I use a brush to clean my teeth.
words.exHe: אני משתמש במברשת כדי לנקות שיניים.
words.gap: I use a ___ to clean my teeth.
words.tip: brush = מברשת, וגם: לצחצח (brush your teeth).

words.ex: My grandpa and I play chess.
words.gap: My grandpa and I play ___. The king is the main piece.
words.tip: chess = שחמט. ch נקרא ״צ׳״.

words.ex: Reading is my hobby.
words.gap: Reading is my ___. I read every day.
words.tip: hobby ברבים: hobbies (ה-y הופך ל-ies).

words.ex: I need more information about the trip.
words.exHe: אני צריך עוד מידע על הטיול.
words.gap: Please give me more ___ about the trip.
words.tip: information = מידע, ואין לה רבים: לא informations.

words.ex: We swim in the pool in summer.
words.gap: We swim in the ___ in summer.
words.tip: pool = בריכה (oo נקרא ״אוּ״). swimming pool.

words.ex: Dan won the race.
words.gap: Dan is the fastest runner in the ___.
words.tip: race = מרוץ. run a race = לרוץ במרוץ.

words.ex: Do not tell anyone. It is a secret!
words.exHe: אל תגידו לאף אחד. זה סוד!
words.gap: Do not tell anyone. It is a ___!
words.tip: secret = סוד. sec + ret.

words.ex: Our football team has eleven players.
words.exHe: בקבוצת הכדורגל שלנו אחד עשר שחקנים.
words.gap: Our football ___ has eleven players.
words.tip: team = צוות / קבוצה. ea נקרא ״אי״.

words.ex: The baby plays with a little toy.
words.gap: The baby plays with a little ___.
words.tip: toy = צעצוע. הרבים: toys (לא toies).
